Strategy and implementation management consultant with over 13 years across
private and public sector programmes. I work with global, national and local
leadership teams, governments, development partners and donors on coordination
and accountability systems, through technical assistance in strategy
development, programme delivery, process improvement and performance
management.

**Areas of expertise:** programme strategy and delivery · global public health ·
grants and portfolio financial management · sustainable health systems
financing.

## Experience

### Partner and Strategic Advisor {.mt-4}
**BK Advisors** · July 2024 – present

Advisory work with global health clients on strategy, delivery and financial
management. Selected engagements:

- **Clinton Health Access Initiative, Papua New Guinea** (2025) — HPV vaccine
  scale-up strategy for cervical cancer prevention.
- **UNICEF** (2025) — polio vaccine management and last-mile delivery strategy.
- **Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance** (2024) — grants and portfolio financial
  management.

### Programme Manager, Country Support {.mt-4}
**Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance** · December 2021 – June 2024 · Geneva

- Managed the Kenya and Lesotho country portfolios, over US$60 million a year.
- Led joint appraisals, mid-term reviews and health system strengthening
  investment plans.
- Supported COVAX engagement through the pandemic response.
- Seconded to the Lesotho Ministry of Health as Gavi Country Liaison Officer.

### Technical Manager {.mt-4}
**Clinton Health Access Initiative** · August 2019 – July 2021 · Uganda

- Led the vaccines delivery and supply chain workstream.
- Ran the programme management office.
- Drove the pilot-to-scale decision on last-mile vaccine delivery.

### Senior Program Coordinator {.mt-4}
**Clinton Health Access Initiative** · July 2017 – July 2019 · Uganda

- Performance management for the Expanded Programme on Immunisation.
- Vaccine supply chain and logistics; ordering and stock management with
  National Medical Stores and UNEPI.

### Program Analyst {.mt-4}
**Clinton Health Access Initiative** · July 2015 – July 2017 · Lesotho and Uganda

- Built data collection and analysis tooling in SurveyCTO/ODK, R and Excel.
- Produced GIS maps, charts and dashboards for programme decision-making.
- Developed the Lesotho health financing planning and budgeting tool, and led
  resource mapping.

### Management Consultant {.mt-4}
**Deloitte Consulting** · April 2012 – July 2014 · Uganda and Tanzania

- Grants management for the USAID/DFID-funded Civil Society Fund.
- Pre-award assessments, monitoring and evaluation, and advisory support.
